headline: Premier League: Elliot Anderson rescues point as Fulham hold Manchester City 1-1 at Etihad
teaser: Rodrigo Muniz opens the scoring from an Oscar Bobb pass before Elliot Anderson equalizes in the 57th minute, leaving City six points behind leaders Arsenal.
story:
Manchester City dropped precious points in the Premier League title chase on Saturday, 21 November, as Fulham earned a gritty 1-1 draw at the Etihad Stadium.

Former City winger Oscar Bobb returned to haunt his old club in the 16th minute, threading an incisive pass for Brazilian forward Rodrigo Muniz to head Fulham into an early 1-0 advantage. City raised the tempo after halftime and restored parity in the 57th minute when midfielder Elliot Anderson fired home.

Despite sustained late pressure, City could not find a winner and finished Matchweek 11 level on 22 points alongside Brighton, trailing league-leading Arsenal (28 points after a 2-2 draw at Newcastle) by six points. Elsewhere in MW11, Liverpool thrashed 10-man Manchester United 4-0 in Mauricio Pochettino opening match in charge.
whyCareReason: Fulham take a shock early lead at the Etihad, putting severe pressure on Manchester City's title chase as the Premier League resumes.
stakes: A victory would pull City level with Brighton on 22 points, while a defeat would leave them six points adrift of Arsenal ahead of the Gunners' clash at Newcastle.
rivalryAngle: Fulham have not won at the Etihad Stadium since 2009, making their early advantage one of the most unexpected twists of the young season.
funFacts: Rodrigo Muniz has scored five goals in his last seven Premier League appearances for Fulham.
Manchester City have conceded the opening goal in four consecutive Premier League matches.
Fulham have registered four shots on target inside the opening half-hour in Manchester.
